name: orca-project-delivery
revisionNote: Remove the redundant evidence and hash apparatus: the six-phase Git-evidence validator, its schema and templates, the dispatch-wave ledger, the per-brief SHA256 digest and the bundled-Skill hash table are gone. Integration safety rests on task isolation, one writer per branch, independent review, a clean-tree/approved-commit pre-merge check run directly by the coordinator, and the full verification suite at the integrated HEAD and at the latest delivery before closure. Machine-readable assignments, raw dispatch receipts, model routing, the coordinator lock and the writer-replacement gate remain. Bundled counts stay 46 Skills, 16 Roles and 4 workflows; English and Chinese guidance move together.
